data.name: Bel
data.gender_notes: Bel is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Bel is recorded in name-lists as “God, Lord”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bel expresses “God, Lord”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bel total 10, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: בל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bel is a title given to various gods in the ancient Near East, representing the supreme deity. In Hebrew, 'Bel' is simply the transliteration of the Akkadian word.

in_greek.name: Βέλλος
in_greek.long_meaning: In Greek, Bel is transliterated as 'Βέλλος' and retains the same meaning as in Hebrew, representing the supreme deity.

in_latin.name: Belus
in_latin.long_meaning: In Latin, 'Belus' is derived from the Greek 'Βέλλος' and retains the same meaning as in Hebrew and Greek, representing the supreme deity.
